nusmp.skill.ancient_soul.description: Extra. Kills leave fragments of old souls in you; part of any magic that hits you never lands. Press to spend 20 fragments and mend yourself.
nusmp.skill.basilisk_skin.description: Ultimate. Scales turn aside much ordinary damage, poison and wither cannot take hold, and melee hits are thrown back as venom. Petrifying Gaze turns the foes before you to stone; Molt sheds the skin for a shield.
nusmp.skill.beelzebuth.description: Ultimate. Gluttony: kills heal you, feed your magicules and stack Hunger (more damage). Devour bites a foe and heals you, Maw drags foes in, Domain eats at everything around you.
nusmp.skill.crocodile_skin.description: Unique. A hide that turns aside a fifth of ordinary damage (more in water, where you also hit harder). Death Roll grips the foe you look at and rolls it three times, healing you.
nusmp.skill.gaia.description: Ultimate. Raise a domain of the earth mother: allies are blessed, strangers cannot break the ground, pillars strike the foes before you, and the domain's gathered life blooms veins of ore.
nusmp.skill.gravity_well.description: Aspectual magic (gravity). Open a well where you look: it pulls foes in, crushes and slows them, then collapses. The second mode collapses your well early.
nusmp.skill.hecate.description: Unique. Three faces of the moon: the Maiden's piercing Moonbolt, the Mother's healing blessing, the Crone's hex of the crossroads. Each is strongest at its own moon phase, and weaker by day.
nusmp.skill.hephaestus_ultimate.descript: Ultimate. Reforge every tool and piece of armour you carry, Temper the weapon in your hand for more damage, or drop a Molten Anvil on the foes where you look.
nusmp.skill.iron_resolve.description: Extra. Wounded, every blow you take stacks Resolve: less damage and, from three stacks, no knockback. Press to Brace and halve all damage for three seconds.
nusmp.skill.kaioken.description: Intrinsic. Toggle. Multiply your own body (x2, x3, x4; x10 and x20 once mastered): more melee damage and speed, but it burns your health every second and leaves you spent.
nusmp.skill.kamehameha.description: Aspectual magic. Hold to gather ki (up to five levels), release to fire a piercing beam. A fuller charge is longer, wider and harder; letting go too early costs nothing.
nusmp.skill.mechanical_eye.description: Intrinsic. Scan Pulse lights the foes around you and reads the nearest one out (health, armour, damage). Weak Point marks the foe you look at: your hits on it are 20% stronger for ten seconds.
nusmp.skill.mechanical_hands.description: Intrinsic. Extend Arms for a longer reach, Telekinesis to pull dropped items and orbs to you, Mend to restore part of the durability of the tool in your hand.
nusmp.skill.meditation.description: Extra. Toggle. Keep still and unhurt and Focus builds: magicules (and later health) return every second. Moving or being hurt breaks it.
nusmp.skill.msg.ancient_soul.echo: The echo of old lives mends you (%s fragments left).
nusmp.skill.msg.basilisk_skin.gaze: Your gaze turns %s foes to stone.
nusmp.skill.msg.beelzebuth.nobody: Nobody is within reach of the maw.
nusmp.skill.msg.elite.evolution.needs: Your mastered %s can evolve into %s. Still needed: %s.
nusmp.skill.msg.elite.off: The elite skills are switched off on this server.
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.bloom_off: Blooming is switched off on this server.
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.bloomed: A vein blooms in the earth: %s blocks of %s (%s veins left today).
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.cap: The earth has given all it will today (%s veins).
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.no_domain: Raise your domain and stand in it to bloom the earth.
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.no_stone: There is no natural stone in reach to bloom.
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.pillars_off: Pillars are switched off on this server.
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.points: The domain has not gathered enough life yet (%s of %s).
nusmp.skill.msg.gaia.starved: Your magicules cannot hold the domain: it fades.
nusmp.skill.msg.gravity_well.none: You have no gravity well open.
nusmp.skill.msg.hephaestus_ultimate.anvi: The Molten Anvil falls on %s foes.
nusmp.skill.msg.hephaestus_ultimate.empt: Hold the weapon to temper in your main hand.
nusmp.skill.msg.kaioken.empty: You have no magicules left: Kaioken ends.
nusmp.skill.msg.kaioken.limit: Your body cannot take any more: Kaioken ends.
nusmp.skill.msg.kaioken.weak: You are too hurt to push your body further.
nusmp.skill.msg.kamehameha.fizzle: The ki scatters: you let go too early.
nusmp.skill.msg.mechanical_eye.read: %s: %s of %s health, armour %s, hits for %s. %s foes scanned.
nusmp.skill.msg.mechanical_hands.no_wear: The item in your hand has nothing to mend.
nusmp.skill.msg.mechanical_hands.nothing: Nothing lies around to pull in.
nusmp.skill.msg.ouroboros.cycle: The cycle turns: %s cooldowns undone (reset number %s).
nusmp.skill.msg.ouroboros.nothing: The cycle has no memory of you yet.
nusmp.skill.msg.ouroboros.rewound: The cycle returns you to where you were.
nusmp.skill.msg.rapheal.read: Analysis: %s, %s of %s health, armour %s, hits for %s%s.
nusmp.skill.msg.runesmiths_insight.bad_i: Runes can only be inscribed on tools and weapons that wear down.
nusmp.skill.msg.runesmiths_insight.empty: Hold an item in your main hand.
nusmp.skill.msg.scavenger.nothing: Nothing lies around to sniff out.
nusmp.skill.msg.scavenger.sniffed: You sniff out %s items; the nearest is %s blocks away.
nusmp.skill.msg.void_edge.imbued: The void clings to your blade.
nusmp.skill.msg.void_sovereign.blocked: There is no room to step.
nusmp.skill.msg.void_sovereign.nullified: Space refuses to move for you.
nusmp.skill.ouroboros.description: Ultimate. The cycle undoes itself: Rewind returns you to where and how you were ten seconds ago, Cycle resets every other cooldown of yours, and a killing blow can be undone by itself once in a while.
nusmp.skill.rapheal.description: Ultimate. Wisdom: some blows are foreseen and turned aside. Analyze reads and marks a foe, Thought Acceleration quickens you and your cooldowns, Dissect strips a foe's blessings.
nusmp.skill.runesmiths_insight.descripti: Extra. Read the runes and enchantments of the item in your hand, or inscribe a Fire, Frost, Thunder or Vitality rune on your weapon for a few minutes.
nusmp.skill.scavenger.description: Extra. Your kills sometimes leave one more stack of loot. Press to Sniff Out every dropped item around you: they glow for twenty seconds.
nusmp.skill.static_chain.description: Aspectual magic (lightning). A bolt strikes the foe you look at and jumps from foe to foe, then tethers them together so they cannot scatter.
nusmp.skill.void_edge.description: Unique. Imbue your melee with the void: each blow deals a second, armour-ignoring hit, breaks shields and strips armour. Void Slash sends a cutting wave through everything in a line.
nusmp.skill.void_sovereign.description: Ultimate. Void Domain: foes inside cannot teleport and foreign projectiles are erased. Void Step cuts a line of space while you cross it. Collapse closes space on the foes around you.
